title: "Results · hypothalamus and PM2.5"
subtitle: "GSE145840 · filtered air versus PM2.5 in chow-fed mice"

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
from _report_utils import summary, read_table, show_table, figure, metric_cards, fmt_p
ROOT = Path.cwd().parent
h = summary("hypothalamus")
v = summary("spatial_viewer")
de = read_table("hypothalamus", "differential_expression.tsv")
hits = de.loc[de.padj.lt(.05)].sort_values("padj")
```

## Analysis population

The main contrast includes four filtered-air controls and three PM2.5-exposed animals receiving standard chow. Four high-fat-diet samples in the same deposit are not added to the control group. Gene-assigned counts are analyzed as seven independent bulk samples; the atlas contributes no exposure replicates. @Rajagopalan2020_32780721

```{python}
metric_cards([
    ("Independent animals", "7", "Filtered air 4 · PM2.5 3"),
    ("Retained genes", f"{h['prefiltered_genes']:,}", "≥10 counts in ≥3 samples"),
    ("Primary FDR hits", str(h['genes_fdr_below_0_05']), "BH-adjusted Wald p < 0.05"),
    ("Hits in spatial panel", str(len(v['primary_fdr_hits_available_in_measured_panel'])), "Tll1 · measured MERFISH reference")
])
show_table(read_table("hypothalamus", "sample_metadata.tsv")[["sample", "label", "condition"]], n=10)
```

## Quality, normalization, and sample relationships

```{python}
q = read_table("hypothalamus", "qc_samples.tsv")
figure("hypothalamus", "sample_quality",
       "Gene-assigned library depth and detected genes in all seven samples. Each bar represents one animal; no sample was excluded.")
figure("hypothalamus", "pca",
       "PCA of the 500 most variable variance-stabilized genes, centered without variance scaling. Individual animals are labeled.")
display(Markdown(f"PC1 explains **{100*h['pca_variance_explained'][0]:.1f}%** of variance and PC2 **{100*h['pca_variance_explained'][1]:.1f}%**. "
                 "The dominant variation does not form a clean exposure-group separation: FA1 and FA2 are distinct, whereas FA3 and FA4 lie closer to the PM samples. "
                 "This is observed heterogeneity, not evidence of a known batch covariate. No principal component was used to manufacture a batch correction."))
figure("hypothalamus", "sample_similarity",
       "Sample correlations and variance-stabilized distances provide complementary views of sample similarity. The matrices retain all seven animals.")
```

Median-of-ratios size factors were estimated within the seven-sample primary dataset. Size factors, count distributions, and Cook's diagnostics are available in the source tables. The source does not provide the per-sample RIN or batch information needed to resolve the observed heterogeneity.

## Differential expression

```{python}
display(Markdown(
    f"The analysis retained **{h['prefiltered_genes']:,}** of **{h['input_gene_rows']:,}** genes. "
    f"**{h['genes_with_finite_adjusted_pvalue']:,}** genes received a finite adjusted p-value; "
    f"**{h['genes_cooks_filtered_for_inference']:,}** were filtered from inferential reporting by Cook's diagnostics. "
    f"At FDR < 0.05, **{h['genes_fdr_below_0_05']} genes** differ between PM and FA: "
    f"**{h['upregulated_fdr_below_0_05_mle_sign']} higher** and **{h['downregulated_fdr_below_0_05_mle_sign']} lower** in PM. "
    f"**{h['exploratory_fdr_and_abs_shrunken_lfc_at_least_1']}** also have absolute shrunken log₂FC ≥ 1."))
show_table(hits[["gene", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE", "padj", "log2FoldChange_shrunk"]], n=20)
figure("hypothalamus", "volcano",
       "Volcano view of the primary gene-level tests. FDR identifies the primary discovery set; shrunken effects are retained separately from the original Wald inference.")
figure("hypothalamus", "ma",
       "Mean expression versus effect size. Low-information and outlier-filtered hypotheses are not converted into significant results.")
```

The small discovery set is not evidence that other genes are unaffected. Conversely, the eleven discoveries do not establish a uniform cellular response or an unmeasured whole-brain effect.

## Sensitivity to individual samples

The complete model was refitted after omitting each animal once. Every omission is reported; none was chosen to replace the primary comparison.

```{python}
loo = read_table("hypothalamus", "leave_one_out_summary.tsv")
stability = read_table("hypothalamus", "leave_one_out_primary_hits.tsv")
show_table(loo, n=10)
show_table(stability[["gene", "primary_padj", "runs_same_lfc_direction", "runs_fdr_below_0_05", "minimum_leave_one_out_lfc", "maximum_leave_one_out_lfc"]], n=20)
```

All eleven primary hits retain their direction in seven of seven fits, but **none remains FDR-significant in all seven fits**. The total discovery count ranges from zero to 825 across omissions. This sensitivity limits the certainty of gene-level discovery and any spatial scenario derived from it. Omitting a control that increases the discovery count is not a justification for excluding that control.

```{python}
check = ROOT / "results/hypothalamus/independent_deseq2_check/summary.json"
if check.exists():
    comparison = json.loads(check.read_text())
    display(Markdown(
        "The independent R/DESeq2 cross-check uses the same 19,452 finite-p hypotheses and the same 159 Cook-filtered genes. "
        "All eleven primary hits remain significant in R; R additionally identifies **Tnrc6c**, whose FDR is 0.0399 in R and 0.0521 in Python. "
        "**Tll1** remains significant in both implementations (FDR 0.00330 in R; 0.00350 in Python). "
        "Effect estimates agree closely (Pearson correlation >0.999999). "
        "This [software comparison](downloads/hypothalamus/independent_deseq2_check/summary.json) does not provide biological replication or resolve sample heterogeneity. "
        "The fixed Python primary result is retained, including its threshold-sensitive genes."))
```

## Functional enrichment

```{python}
e = summary("enrichment")["datasets"]["hypothalamus"]
display(Markdown(
    f"GO Biological Process over-representation analysis found **{e['ORA']['significant_up_terms_BH_FDR_0_05']} higher-expression** "
    f"and **{e['ORA']['significant_down_terms_BH_FDR_0_05']} lower-expression** significant terms after BH correction. "
    "The small, partially annotated discovery list does not support a confirmed pathway conclusion."
))
```

Preranked GSEA detects broader signed rank patterns, including overlapping ciliary and neuronal/synaptic annotations, but these results are exploratory. They do not remove the control heterogeneity, establish independent pathway mechanisms, or substitute for additional animals. The [functional-enrichment page](enrichment.qmd) reports the full tested universe, annotation coverage, rank exclusions, and algorithmic FDR separately from ORA.

## Spatial interpretation

```{python}
tll = de.set_index("gene").loc["Tll1"]
lower, upper = tll.log2FoldChange - 1.96*tll.lfcSE, tll.log2FoldChange + 1.96*tll.lfcSE
display(Markdown(
    f"**Tll1** is the only primary FDR hit measured in this atlas panel. Its bulk MLE log₂FC is "
    f"**{tll.log2FoldChange:.3f}**, its shrunken log₂FC is **{tll.log2FoldChange_shrunk:.3f}**, and its FDR is **{fmt_p(tll.padj)}**. "
    f"The central visualization multiplier is therefore **{2**tll.log2FoldChange_shrunk:.3f}×**; the pointwise group MLE interval corresponds to "
    f"**{2**lower:.3f}–{2**upper:.3f}×**. These multipliers define scenarios on the measured reference; they are not per-cell exposure measurements."
))
```

[Open the reference and simulation side by side](viewer.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

Bulk-to-panel matching uses exact mouse gene symbols. An additional [identifier check](downloads/report_validation/significant_gene_panel_match.json) resolves unambiguous official GAF aliases for all eleven primary hits: it finds no additional measured hit beyond Tll1. Genes without an eligible exact matched effect remain reference-only; related family members are not substituted for absent genes.

## Gene products, functions, and spatial priorities

The new [gene profiles](gene_profiles.qmd) preserve the complete selected discovery list with encoded products, current biotypes, molecular functions, official source links, effect estimates and panel coverage. The [cortex 3D viewer](cortex_viewer.qmd) provides a separate ACA reference and cortical effects; the [hypothalamus viewer](viewer.qmd) adds measured-gene shortcuts and a three-gene comparison. Unmeasured genes remain in the bulk report without imputed spatial values.
